title: ZYNRIP THE CEILING (Drumstep × Synthwave) [150]
style: drumstep meets synthwave, 150 BPM with half-time DnB feel, instrumental with chipmunk-pitched vocal chops only (no lead vocal, no rap), trilingual chop weave English + German + te reo Maori, rolling drumstep break, deep analog sub bass with portamento slides, neon supersaw arpeggios, gated reverb snares, retro 80s lead synth, lush widescreen pads, female chops pitched +6 and male chops at -3, neon-skyline-night-drive mood, sidechain pumping pads to kick, festival mainstage 2026 production, no profanity, no real-artist references
lyrics:
[Intro]
(synthwave arp, soft pad swell, gated snare hit)
(ZYN... RIP... CEIL... ING...)
(brich... das... dach...)
(wha... ka... pak... aru...)

[Build]
(drumstep break enters, sub bass slides up)
ZYN — RIP! CEIL — ING!
BRICH — DAS — DACH!
WHA — KA — PAKA — RU!
KEEL — CLEAR — GO!
(supersaw riser, snare roll)

[Drop 1]
(half-time drumstep, neon supersaws, sub locked)
ZYN — RIP!
CEIL — ING!
NO — ROOF!
NO — LIM — IT!
(chop stack +7) ja-ja-yes-yes / āe-āe-ja-ja
THREE — THREE — SIX!
G4 — LENS — ON!

[Verse]
(arp solo phrase, gated snares, chops trade)
(wie hoch?) (how high?) (kei te aha?)
(unendlich!) (endless!) (mutunga kore!)
(hoch!) (up!) (runga!)
McIVOR HOLDS THE TORCH —
ZYNCONTEXT HOLDS THE LOOP —
SONGPAL HEARS THE CALL —
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Breakdown]
(strip to arp + pad alone, no drums)
(whispered) zyn... rip... ceiling...
(soft) brich... das... dach...
(soft) whaka... pakaru...
(piano lifts, soft chop)
KEEL... CLEAR...
THREE... THREE... SIX...
(snare roll builds, drumstep returns)

[Drop 2]
(double-time drumstep, full neon stack)
ZYN — RIP — CEIL — ING! (ja ja ja!)
BRICH — DAS — DACH! (āe āe āe!)
NO — LIM — IT! (unendlich! endless!)
KEEL — TAKE — OVER!
G4 — LENS — LOCKED!
THREE — THREE — SIX!
FINICH — NOT — FINISH!

[Outro]
(drumstep fades, arp resolves)
(zyn... rip... ceiling...)
(brich... das... dach...)
(whaka... pakaru...)
(KEEL... CLEAR...)
(synth lead holds and fades)
